subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Tell 12-hour time in hours, half hours and quarter hours, minutes on analogue clocks; length of time

show.line: The long hand on three is quarter past. On nine, it is quarter to. Quarter past two. Quarter to three!

rounds.prompt: Which clock shows quarter past six?
Which clock shows quarter to nine?
rounds.praise: Yes! Long hand on nine, almost nine o'clock.

rounds.prompt: Look at the clock. Long hand on three, short hand just past four. Say the time.
Count the minutes in five minute jumps from twelve to three. How many minutes?
rounds.praise: Fifteen minutes! A quarter of an hour.

rounds.prompt: It is quarter past seven. Which digital clock matches?
Quarter past or quarter to? Sort the clocks.

rounds.story: Soccer practice starts at quarter past three and ends at quarter to four. How long is practice?

hints: Long hand on three is quarter past. Long hand on nine is quarter to.
Quarter to means fifteen minutes before the next hour.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this clock.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Long hand on nine, short hand near five. Quarter past five!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Long hand on nine is quarter to. Quarter to five.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Long hand on nine. Fifteen minutes until five. Quarter to five!

parent_line: Can read quarter past and quarter to on a clock.
